facts.text: The poster over our bar. Some nights it's all anybody looks at.
facts.why: The poster in the film is the beach billboard Carlito stares at as he dies, not one over a bar. The club is called Paradise.
facts.fix: The beach poster Carlito stares at to the last. Easy to see why.

facts.text: Paradise flan -- caramel and coconut, for the beach postcard Carlito keeps
facts.why: No postcard in the plot or transcript. What Carlito looks at is the Caribbean beach billboard as he dies.
facts.fix: Paradise flan -- caramel and coconut, for the beach poster Carlito stares at

vibe.verdict: A warm, moody club and train ticket menu that gets Carlito's dream of the islands right. The poster caption is the only spot that moves the film around.
